select.openClassNote: These eight selects were not in the interactive open list. Selector classes are ant-select ant-select-enabled ant-select-allow-clear. Dropdown, ant-select-search__field, and open/focused/enabled are the same page's flat ant-select probes already used by the pb basic and region fillers.

liveReadback.note: Same-page closed .ant-select-search__field can have getClientRects().length 0 while .ant-select-selection[role=combobox] is visible. Clone text can be 请选择 plus the label plus the value. Read .ant-select-selection-selected-value, or strip that placeholder prefix. 成绩's page text is 请选择成绩, so the inventory token 成绩 is that placeholder with 请选择 removed, not a captured score option.
